summary: Frontend-only testing of Charlie's one-sentence how-to voice chain across 10 game menus + 2 sub-modes (Snail-or-Cheetah, Name-That-Note Place-It) + 3 Who's-Got-The-Rhythm modes. All auto-chains fire the expected host tagline then exactly ONE Charlie how-to request. All 13 howto-voice-* speaker buttons are present/visible and clicking them does NOT throw and does NOT start the game. Dynamic sub-mode buttons (howto-voice-namenote-place, howto-voice-boom-copy/match/trail, howto-voice-tempo) appear and fire their expected mp3 requests. Mobile layout at 844x390 fits (ear-trainer, name-that-note). Game-start regression passes.
observations: Host tagline mp3 is requested TWICE on each menu mount (React 18 StrictMode double-invokes useEffect in dev). Chaining logic correctly cancels the first closure so Charlie's how-to still fires exactly ONCE, which matches the spec. Not a bug, but worth noting for prod.

Speaker-button clicks after the auto-chain fire NO new network request because voice.js has already added the mp3 id to the `missing` set (file 404). This matches the documented 'remembered as missing and skipped silently' behavior. Click handler does not throw, stopPropagation works (game does not start).
404s for /assets/voice/*.mp3 are expected (no recordings yet) — not reported as bugs.

test_results.speaker_buttons_present_all_10_routes: PASS (jukebox, kazoo, earquest, notematch, detective, sightread, namenote-name, shred, robot, funfacts) — visible, click does not throw

test_results.layout_844x390_name_that_note: PASS (speaker btn at x=389 doesn't overlap mode cards at x=57-224; fits viewport)

critical_code_review_comments: useVoiceTagline.js effect runs twice under React.StrictMode causing the tagline mp3 to be requested twice. The chaining still produces only one how-to call (correct per spec), but if you want to avoid the double tag request add an eslint-disable + a mounted-ref guard, or remove StrictMode in production builds.

voice.js: `missing` is module-scoped and never resets within a session — speaker buttons therefore produce zero audible playback once the host tagline/how-to has 404'd. Fine for now (files absent) but when real mp3s land, double-check cache behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Charlie how-to voice chaining & speaker buttons verified across 10 main menus + sub-modes (NTN place, Snail-or-Cheetah, Boom Garden copy/match/trail). voice.js `missing` cache suppresses repeat 404s, so speaker-button clicks AFTER the auto-chain fire no network request — verify silently (click should not throw) rather than expecting a request. For Boom Garden fresh reloads sometimes keep the how-to overlay open; close via 'Back to modes' before clicking another mode tile.
